segments.en: I will tell of Dionysus, the son of glorious Semele, how he appeared on a jutting headland by the shore of the fruitless sea, seeming like a stripling in the first flush of manhood: his rich, dark hair was waving about him, and on his strong shoulders he wore a purple robe. Presently there came swiftly over the sparkling sea Tyrsenian Probably not Etruscans, but the non-Hellenic peoples of Thrace and (according to Thucydides) of Lemnos and Athens. Cp. Herodotus i. 57; Thucydides iv. 109. pirates on a well-decked ship —a miserable doom led them on. When they saw him they made signs to one another and sprang out quickly, and seizing him straightway put him on board their ship exultingly; for they thought him the son of heaven-nurtured kings. They sought to bind him with rude bonds, but the bonds would not hold him, and the withes fell far away from his hands and feet: and he sat with a smile in his dark eyes. Then the helmsman understood all and cried out at once to his fellows and said: “Madmen! what god is this whom you have taken and bind, strong that he is? Not even the well-built ship can carry him. Surely this is either Zeus or Apollo who has the silver bow,
segments.zh: 我將述說戴奧尼索斯，光榮的塞墨勒之子，他如何出現在無生之海的崎嶇岬角，形如初入男子漢年紀的少年：他濃密烏黑的頭髮飄揚在身邊，在他強壯的肩膀上披著紫色的長袍。不久，泰爾塞尼亞海盜們駕著一艘構造精良的船迅速越過閃耀的海面——一場悲慘的命運引領著他們。他們見到他時彼此做出手勢，急忙跳出船去，立刻抓住他放上船，歡欣鼓舞；因為他們以為他是天養之王的兒子。他們尋求用粗糙的繩索捆綁他，但繩索無法束縛他，柳條從他的手和腳上脫落遠去：而他坐著，眼中帶著微笑。那時舵手明白了一切，立刻大聲向他的同伴呼喊，說道：「瘋子們！你們抓住了什麼神，要將他捆綁，他這樣強大？連這艘構造完善的船都無法承載他。確然這是宙斯或是銀弓的阿波羅，

segments.en: or Poseidon, for he looks not like mortal men but like the gods who dwell on Olympus. Come, then, let us set him free upon the dark shore at once: do not lay hands on him, lest he grow angry and stir up dangerous winds and heavy squalls.” So said he: but the master chid him with taunting words: “Madman, mark the wind and help hoist sail on the ship: catch all the sheets. As for this fellow we men will see to him: I reckon he is bound for Egypt or for Cyprus or to the Hyperboreans or further still. But in the end he will speak out and tell us his friends and all his wealth and his brothers, now that providence has thrown him in our way.” When he had said this, he had mast and sail hoisted on the ship, and the wind filled the sail and the crew hauled taut the sheets on either side. But soon strange things were seen among them. First of all sweet, fragrant wine ran streaming throughout all the black ship and a heavenly smell arose, so that all the seamen were seized with amazement when they saw it. And all at once a vine spread out both ways along the top of the sail with many clusters hanging down from it,
segments.zh: 或是波塞頓，因為他看起來不似凡人而似住在奧林匹斯的諸神。來吧，讓我們立刻將他放開在黑暗的岸邊：不要動手抓他，免得他發怒，興起危險的狂風和猛烈的暴雨。」他如是言：但船長用嘲笑的言辭責罵他：「瘋子，留意風向，幫我揚帆在船上：抓住所有的繩索。至於這個傢伙，我們男人會照料他：我料想他要往埃及或塞浦路斯或往北方極域或更遠去。但終將他會開口告訴我們他的朋友和他的所有財富和他的兄弟，既然天意已將他投入我們的道路。」他說完這番話，就升起了船上的桅杆和帆，風填滿了帆，船員們在兩側拉緊了繩索。但旋即在他們中間出現了奇異的事物。首先，甘甜芬芳的葡萄酒在黑色的船上到處流淌，天界的香氣升起，使得所有的海員見了都陷入驚嘆之中。霎時一株葡萄藤在帆頂沿著兩個方向蔓延，許多葡萄串垂掛下來，

segments.en: and a dark ivy-plant twined about the mast, blossoming with flowers, and with rich berries growing on it; and all the thole-pins were covered with garlands. When the pirates saw all this, then at last they bade the helmsman to put the ship to land. But the god changed into a dreadful lion there on the ship, in the bows, and roared loudly: amidships also he showed his wonders and created a shaggy bear which stood up ravening, while on the forepeak was the lion glaring fiercely with scowling brows. And so the sailors fled into the stern and crowded bemused about the right-minded helmsman, until suddenly the lion sprang upon the master and seized him; and when the sailors saw it they leapt out overboard one and all into the bright sea, escaping from a miserable fate, and were changed into dolphins. But on the helmsman Dionysus had mercy and held him back and made him altogether happy, saying to him: “Take courage, good ; you have found favour with my heart. I am loud-crying Dionysus whom Cadmus' daughter Semele bare of union with Zeus.” Hail, child of fair-faced Semele! He who forgets you can in no wise order sweet song.
segments.zh: 黑色的常春藤盤繞著桅杆，綻放著花朵，上面長著豐富的漿果；所有的槳座都被花冠覆蓋了。當海盜們看見這一切時，他們終於命令舵手將船駛向陸地。但神在船上，在船首之處變成了一頭可怕的獅子，大聲咆哮：在船的中央他也展示了他的奇蹟，造出一隻蓬亂的熊直立起來，貪婪地站著，而在船艏是那頭獅子兇狠地瞪視著，眉頭緊蹙。於是水手們逃入船尾，困惑地擁擠在思慮清明的舵手周圍，直到獅子突然撲向船長並抓住他；當水手們看見時，他們一個個都跳出舷外進入明亮的海中，逃離悲慘的命運，並被變成了海豚。但戴奧尼索斯對舵手心生憐憫，攔阻了他，使他完全幸福，向他言說：「鼓起勇氣，善良者；你已獲得我心的歡心。我是聲名赫赫的戴奧尼索斯，由卡德摩斯的女兒塞墨勒與宙斯結合所生。」向美貌的塞墨勒之子致敬！凡忘卻你的人絕無法譜寫甘甜的歌謠。
